digest.component_or_area: binding store rotation and persistence layer
propositions: Move last_get_pass rotation stamps from scattered bindings.json entries into a dedicated .bridge_state/get_rotation.json sidecar file while maintaining compatibility with old binaries.

New binaries must write rotation state to both the sidecar and legacy inline field, reading the chronological max(sidecar, legacy) to ensure mixed-version correctness under either old-then-new or new-then-old execution order.
The explicit local reconcile commit path must stage and commit get_rotation.json without git add -A, exercising both the staging list and basename membership check.
Rotation order and behavior must remain identical whether all binaries are new, all legacy, or interleaved old-new sequences.
reconcile-check against pre-migration stores must not create get_rotation.json and must not modify git status.
Module extraction to get_rotation.py must stay within size constraints while respecting the locked 800-line policy for binding_store.py and outbound_differ.py.
